title: Take me there: Fossil Creek is an oasis in Arizona wilderness
description: The road to Fossil Creek seemed to disappear into the Arizona wilderness, winding through rugged hills and forests of pine, juniper and oak. With every turn, the landscape became quieter and wilder.

title: Maine joins lawsuit over federal deal to redirect offshore wind investments to fossil fuels
description: Attorneys general from eight states claim the administration illegally used $1.4 billion in public funding to pay wind companies to invest in fossil fuels.

title: UN chief urges countries to adopt fossil fuel transition plans with timelines
description: In his last speech to the UN General Assembly, António Guterres for the first time called on every nation to deliver a plan to phase out coal, oil and gas while protecting workers

title: Casts of Star Trek, Starship Troopers among many guests to be at Ancient City Con
description: Thousands of comic, anime, and other pop culture fans will be making their way to St. Johns County this weekend for Ancient City Con. The convention will be at the St. Johns Convention Center from September 25-27.
